non_claim: This artifact records policy and executable evidence boundaries only. It does not claim a successful full scan, dispatch, SARIF upload, or Advanced Security availability.

policy.blocking_condition: A finding blocks only when its SARIF level is error, or when the Semgrep process exits nonzero for an execution or output error.
policy.bundled_findings: Bundled findings are counted separately by SARIF level; warning, note, and none are retained and reported but do not block.
policy.custom_findings: CoreLink rules declare metadata policy explicit-error and severity ERROR; an unsuppressed custom finding at level error blocks.
policy.suppression: In-source suppressions are accepted only after approved_suppression_sites(root) passes and the nine returned (repo-relative URI, uses-line, rule-id) coordinates are matched exactly; raw ERROR counts remain retained and approved-suppressed counts are reported separately.
policy.semgrep_error_flag: not used; the evaluator applies the explicit SARIF ERROR policy and preserves nonzero scanner failures

sarif.advanced_security_unavailable: The scan remains authoritative locally and SARIF is retained as an artifact; upload is reported as unavailable_or_unverified unless the upload action explicitly succeeds.

requires: A D03 bundle run with both SARIF populations and the generated report
No explicit ERROR findings, or remediation/approved suppression for every ERROR
Truthful upload outcome or retained artifact evidence when Advanced Security is unavailable
closure.owner_action: Dispatch and Advanced Security account state remain external owner actions.
